evidence_excerpts: For mpeg2, procedure cloning reduces WCET estimates by 63.6% for standard cloning and 62.7% for WCET-aware cloning; epic has a 693.7% code-size increase after standard cloning and 357.9% after WCET-aware cloning.
text: WCET-aware procedure cloning improves WCET estimates by specializing functions whose data-dependent loop bounds become constant in cloned calling contexts, but it trades timing precision for code-size growth.
